resumeText:
JAMES O'CONNELL
Sydney, NSW | 0400 123 456 | james.oconnell@example.com | linkedin.com/in/jamesoconnell
Australian Citizen — full working rights

SUMMARY
Recent coding bootcamp graduate with hands-on experience building REST APIs in Node.js and Python. Completed a short backend contract building internal tooling for a logistics startup. Looking to grow as a Junior Backend Developer in Sydney, focusing on clean API design and database work.

SKILLS
JavaScript, Node.js, Express, Python, SQL, PostgreSQL, Git, REST APIs, Docker, AWS, Kubernetes, Jest

EXPERIENCE

Backend Developer (Contract)
RouteWise Logistics, Sydney — 02/2024 to 04/2024
Short-term contract to support the internal tools team while they hired a permanent developer.
- Responsible for writing REST APIs for the internal shipment tracking tool.
- Attended daily stand-ups and sprint planning with the tools team.
- Wrote unit tests for new endpoints using Jest.
- Maintained the PostgreSQL schema for shipment records.

Customer Support Officer
BrightPath Telecom, Sydney — 06/2022 to 12/2023
- Handled inbound customer calls regarding billing and account issues.
- Escalated technical faults to the network operations team.
- Trained two new starters on the internal ticketing system.

EDUCATION

Diploma of Software Development
Sydney Coding Academy — 08/2023 to 01/2024
- Full-time intensive program covering JavaScript, Node.js, SQL and REST API design.
- Capstone project: built a task management API with authentication and role-based access.

Bachelor of Commerce
Macquarie University, Sydney — 02/2018 to 11/2021

PROJECTS

TaskFlow API
- Built a task management REST API with Node.js, Express and PostgreSQL, including JWT authentication.
- Added input validation and error handling middleware to prevent malformed requests from reaching the database.
- Wrote 40+ Jest tests covering core endpoints.

Recipe Finder
- Built a Python Flask app that lets users search recipes by ingredient using a public API.
- Implemented caching to reduce repeated calls to the external API.

Expense Splitter
- Small command-line tool in Python for splitting shared expenses between housemates.
- Added CSV export of settlement summaries.

REFEREES
Available on request
